summary: On May 6, 2026, shareholders of Inspira Technologies Oxy B.H.N. Ltd. approved an amendment to the company’s articles to change its name to Qtrex Quantum Ltd., which became effective on May 10, 2026. The company will begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker QTEX on May 20, 2026. The report on Form 6-K discloses this name change and a related press release. No shareholder rights, CUSIP, or share certificates are affected. This is a routine corporate name change and not a special situation.
